quotes.text:
/**
 * Compares folders for display in the right order. Folders with an ordinal in
 * the database are sorted ahead of those without. Folders without an ordinal
 * are sorted in alphabetical order.
 *
 * A future version of this class will handle special folder types (e.g.
 * Inbox, which goes ahead of ordinary folders).
 */

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: FolderComparator.h still describes special-folder order as a future version, but the current implementation already has SpecialFlagsOrder and tests special folders. The sort tests also retain inverted descriptions above testNullOrdinals and testNonNullOrdinals. For this component, compare comments with actual fields and assertions when reviewing changes, and update obsolete descriptions. These concrete source mismatches justify a scoped manual recommendation; they do not establish reviewer approval for a project-wide prose rule. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Update Panorama comments when a planned behavior becomes implemented
